body: The new skeleton loading state uses `role="status" aria-live="polite"` but no readable loading text. This reduces screen reader feedback compared to the previous "Loading…" text. Add an `sr-only` label inside the status region (and similarly consider an accessible label/`role="status"` for the loading overlay) so assistive tech users get an explicit loading announcement.

Inline styles are introduced for switching the table layout (`style={{ tableLayout: 'fixed' }}`), but repo guidelines forbid inline styles (see .github/copilot-instructions.md:16). This can be expressed with Tailwind instead (e.g. conditionally apply `table-fixed`/`[table-layout:fixed]` via `cn()`), keeping styling consistent and avoiding style prop usage.
